periocular_spatial_geometry.dominant_axis_orientation: Oblique orientation, angled approximately 45 degrees downward from the medial canthus toward the temporal region.
periocular_spatial_geometry.aspect_ratio_factor: Elongated oval, with the primary axis approximately 1.7 times the length of the secondary axis.
periocular_spatial_geometry.inferior_centroid_shift: Moderate downward tapering, with the vertical center of mass situated slightly above the geometric midpoint of the patch.

dorsal_band_topology.vertex_curvature_index: Shallow U-shape profile along the posterior margin as it transitions to the white lumbar fur.
dorsal_band_topology.normalized_band_thickness: The transverse band occupies approximately 35 percent of the visible vertical torso height.

cranial_pinna_bounding_metrics.inter_bounding_box_euclidean_distance: Wide lateral separation, estimated at 1.8 times the basal width of a single pinna.
cranial_pinna_bounding_metrics.apex_contour_smoothness: Smooth, semi-circular convex curvature at the superior margins.

other_distinctive_markers: Pronounced yellowish-tan discoloration of the ventral fur compared to the stark white cranial and thoracic fur.
